description: Searches one-way flights on AlgoTrips for one day between two cities or airports, with current prices. Returns up to 5 options (airline, flight numbers, times, duration, stops, baggage, refund, fare and price for all passengers), each with a link to book it on AlgoTrips, and a link to see every flight. Nothing is booked or paid here. The prices are the signed-in AlgoTrips account's own; needs the person to be signed in to AlgoTrips. A city that is not found or is shared by several cities returns close matches instead (status needs_changes).

adults.description: Adults (12 and over) travelling, 1 to 9. Left out: 1.

cabin.description: Cabin: economy, premium_economy, business or first. Left out: every cabin.

childrenAges.description: Each child's age, 2 to 11. Adults and children together are at most 9.

date.description: The day of the flight, YYYY-MM-DD, from today up to 330 days ahead.

departAfter.description: The earliest departure time, HH:MM (24-hour clock, local time at the departure airport).

departBefore.description: The latest departure time, HH:MM (24-hour clock, local time at the departure airport).

from.description: Where the flight leaves from: a city ("Mumbai", or "Hyderabad, India" when the name is shared) or a 3-letter airport code ("BOM").

infants.description: Infants under 2 (on a lap), 0 to 4, no more than the adults.

preferredTime.description: A preferred departure time, HH:MM. Without departAfter or departBefore, only flights leaving within 2 hours of it are returned. The flight nearest to it is always among the options.

to.description: Where the flight goes: a city or a 3-letter airport code, as for from.

name: search_flights

arrives.description: Local time at the arrival airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

departs.description: Local time at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

price.description: Every passenger together, rounded up; null when no price can be given.

party.description: The travellers the search was for (adults left out = 1).

title: Search flights
